topic: Using Material Properties to Solve Environmental Problems
key_concepts: Science process skills include grouping, classifying, communicating, and open-mindedness
Surveys gather information about community environmental issues
Survey data can be presented as fractions or pictographs
Analyzing data helps identify priority environmental problems
Properties of materials can be applied to solve environmental problems
Chemicals and trash can pollute water and harm living things
Pollution from factories and households can make rivers murky
Open-mindedness and communication are needed in solving environmental issues
Possible solutions should be presented for peer evaluation
A final solution plan includes introduction, problem, proposed solution, materials, and pr
The procedure section gives a step-by-step method for solving the problem
